title: Template
description: Canonical Template contract per DEVOS-SPEC-027 and authoring rules of DEVOS-SPEC-053. Templates are pure declarative data: no executable steps, no environment reads, no secret values, deterministic output for identical inputs.

structure.description: Static declarative content containing placeholders substituted only from validated parameters.

compatibility.description: Supported manifest or schema versions range per DEVOS-SPEC-027.

parameters.description: Declared parameters validated before any generation occurs.

defaults.description: Top-level default values for optional parameters; each default MUST satisfy its own constraints.

items.description: Illustrative parameter sets for documentation purposes.

name.description: Stable identifier referenced by placeholders in the structure.

type.description: Exactly one type per parameter per DEVOS-SPEC-027.

required.description: Required parameters MUST NOT rely on defaults to become satisfiable.

description.description: Shown to callers before they supply values.

default.description: Optional only; MUST satisfy its own constraints before the Template is valid.

values.description: Exhaustive allowed values for enum parameters.

origin.description: Where this template came from; recorded at registration and preserved thereafter.

contributingPlugin.description: Plugin identifier when contributed per DEVOS-SPEC-035 contribution rules.

$comment: Placeholders referencing undeclared parameters are invalid; validation of declaration integrity belongs to domain stages per DEVOS-SPEC-035.
